highlights: Yesido YF19 Turbo Speed Fan Blower
The Yesido YF19 is a portable, multi-functional device that primarily serves as a powerful turbo fan blower.
It is designed for versatile use in car detailing, computer cleaning, outdoor activities like camping, and general household dust removal.
Motor: Equipped with an ultra-high-speed brushless motor that reaches 130,000 RPM, providing strong and efficient airflow.
Performance: Generates a blowing force of 165-200g and suction power up to 10,000 Pa.
Speed Control: Features 100 levels of stepless speed adjustment, allowing precise control for different tasks.
Battery: Powered by dual 4000 mAh lithium battery, offering approximately 12 minutes of runtime at maximum speed.
Display: An integrated LED digital screen shows real-time battery percentage and current speed settings.
Material: Constructed from durable ABS, PC, and a full aluminum alloy impeller for heat resistance and longevity.
Charging: Uses a Type-C charging port, with a full charge taking about 4-5 hours.
Portability: Features a compact and lightweight design, making it easy to carry and handle.
